key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the menu

key.name: actions
key.summary: Enabled actions, in display order
key.description: Built-in actions: lock-screen, logout, suspend, hibernate, switch-user, restart, power-off. Custom actions use the id from custom-actions.

key.name: custom-actions
key.summary: User-defined actions
key.description: Each entry is (id, name, icon name, command line). The id starts with "custom-". The command line is split like a shell would, but runs without a shell.

key.name: layout
key.summary: How the buttons are arranged
key.description: "auto" picks the arrangement from the number of buttons (1-3 in a row, 4 as 2x2, 5 like a die face, 6 as 2x3); "grid" uses a fixed number of columns.

key.name: columns
key.summary: Number of buttons per row in the grid layout

key.name: button-size
key.summary: Button size in pixels

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the buttons in pixels

key.name: spacing
key.summary: Space between buttons in pixels

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Icon size as a percentage of the button size

key.name: focus-scale
key.summary: Size of the selected button as a percentage (100 disables the growth)

key.name: highlight-color
key.summary: Highlight color as #rrggbb; empty uses the system accent color

key.name: show-panel
key.summary: Draw the panel behind the buttons

key.name: show-labels
key.summary: Show the action name below the icon

key.name: backdrop-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the background dimming (percent)

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Monitor where the menu opens

key.name: initial-focus
key.summary: Action selected when the menu opens: the first one or the last one used

key.name: last-action
key.summary: Last action run from the menu (internal)

key.name: close-on-click-outside
key.summary: Close the menu when clicking outside of it

key.name: confirm-mode
key.summary: Which actions ask for confirmation
key.description: "none" runs every action at once, "all" asks for every action, "custom" asks only for the actions in confirm-list.

key.name: confirm-list
key.summary: Actions that ask for confirmation when confirm-mode is "custom"

key.name: confirm-default
key.summary: Button focused when the confirmation opens

key.name: confirm-timeout
key.summary: Seconds before a confirmation runs the action on its own

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show a button in the top bar
